def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):

def bridge_shapes(grid, fill=4):
    """Between a top and bottom shape of one color, separated by a solid divider row of another color, fill the shapes' shared columns with fill from below the top shape to the divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    botr = next(i for i in range(h - 1, -1, -1) if any(grid[i]) and len(set(grid[i])) > 1)
    botc = next(v for v in grid[botr] if v)
    bar = next(i for i, r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r)) == 1 and r[0] not in (0, botc))
    red = grid[bar][0]
    tr = next(i for i in range(bar) if any(v not in (0, red) for v in grid[i]))
    topc = next(v for v in grid[tr] if v not in (0, red))
    cols = {j for j in range(w) if grid[tr][j] == topc} & {j for j in range(w) if grid[botr][j] == botc}
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]
    for i in range(tr + 1, bar):
        for j in cols:
            out[i][j] = fill
    return out
'''
